description: Redesign DashboardPage (EcoStep Central) with sentence-case Bricolage Grotesque headings, a single quiet 'Read-only' chip for public users, status pill (wifi/wifi-off + Live/Offline), last reading timestamp, KPI cards showing '--' when offline (not '0.0'), dim offline cards, skeleton loading, and landing page design tokens. Remove PublicUserBanner entirely.
steps: Open frontend/src/features/dashboard/pages/DashboardPage.tsx, delete the <PublicUserBanner /> line and its import statement
Update page background style to backgroundColor: 'var(--landing-bg)' (was 'theme === dark ? #0B132B : #F5F7FA')

Open frontend/src/features/dashboard/components/DashboardHeader.tsx, change title to 'EcoStep Central' (sentence case, NOT ALL CAPS), apply fontFamily: 'Bricolage Grotesque, system-ui, sans-serif', fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 'clamp(30px, 4vw, 44px)', letterSpacing: '-0.03em'
In DashboardHeader, change subtitle to sentence case, fontSize: 15px, fontWeight: 400, color: 'var(--landing-mute)'

In DashboardHeader, if isPublicUser prop is true, render a 'Read-only' chip:
Read-only
with tooltip title='You are viewing as a guest. Monitoring and analytics are read-only.'

In DashboardHeader, add status pill: import Wifi, WifiOff from lucide-react, render
{systemStatus === 'connected' ? : }{systemStatus === 'connected' ? 'Live' : 'Offline'}
. Add pulse animation for Live status (keyframes in CSS).

In DashboardHeader, add last reading timestamp: useState to track 'N min ago', useEffect with setInterval every 30s to update timestamp based on lastReading time vs Date.now(), render
{timestampText}
Open frontend/src/features/dashboard/components/MetricCard.tsx, add isOffline prop (boolean), when value is undefined OR isOffline is true, display '--' instead of formatted number
In MetricCard, when isOffline is true, apply style={{ opacity: 0.5 }} to the entire card

In MetricCard, update icon tile colors: voltage (color='blue') uses background: 'var(--landing-blue-soft)', color: 'var(--landing-blue)', current (color='amber') uses background: 'var(--landing-amber-soft)', color: 'var(--landing-amber)', power (color='green') uses background: 'var(--landing-soft)', color: 'var(--landing-green)'
In MetricCard, update KPI number style: fontSize: '48px' (44-56px range), fontWeight: 800, fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums', fontFamily: 'Bricolage Grotesque'
In MetricCard, update card style: background: 'var(--landing-surface)', border: '1px solid var(--landing-line)', borderRadius: '28px', padding: '20px 24px'
In DashboardPage.tsx, compute const isOffline = getSystemStatus() === 'disconnected'; and pass isOffline prop to each <MetricCard>
Open frontend/src/features/dashboard/components/HeroEnergyCard.tsx, update background to 'var(--landing-surface)', border to '1px solid var(--landing-line)', borderRadius to '32px'
In HeroEnergyCard, change title font to Bricolage Grotesque weight 600, 20px
In HeroEnergyCard, change energy value font to Bricolage Grotesque weight 800, 56px, tabular-nums
In HeroEnergyCard, if Recharts chart is rendered, set stroke color to 'var(--landing-green)', grid stroke to 'var(--landing-line)'

In HeroEnergyCard error state, replace raw 'Network Error' with friendly message: 'Unable to load energy data', circle-alert icon, Retry button with background: 'var(--landing-green)', borderRadius: '999px'

Update responsive styles in DashboardPage.tsx: desktop (1100px+) KPIs 3 across, tablet (768-1023px) KPIs 2x2 grid, mobile (<560px) single column with 2-column KPI grid if space allows. Use CSS media queries or inline responsive styles.

Add accessibility: all icon-only buttons get aria-label, status pill has role='status' aria-live='polite', chart SVG gets aria-label with summary text, add prefers-reduced-motion media query to skip transitions if user prefers reduced motion
acceptance_criteria: PublicUserBanner does not render on DashboardPage
Page background is var(--landing-bg) in both light and dark themes
Page title is 'EcoStep Central' (sentence case, Bricolage Grotesque, 800 weight)
Public users see a single small 'Read-only' chip with info icon
Status pill shows 'Live' (green, pulse animation) or 'Offline' (red, no pulse)
Last reading timestamp displays and updates every 30 seconds
KPI cards show '--' when value is undefined or system is offline, NOT '0.0'
KPI numbers use Bricolage Grotesque 800 weight, 48px, tabular-nums
All cards use var(--landing-surface) background, 1px solid var(--landing-line) border, 28-32px radius
HeroEnergyCard uses same styling, error state is friendly (no raw error text)
Skeleton loading appears on initial page load (if isInitialLoading is true)
Responsive layouts work: 3-column KPIs on desktop, 2x2 grid on tablet, single column on mobile
Focus ring is visible (3px solid var(--landing-green)) on all interactive elements
All aria-labels and roles are present
verification: Run 'npm run build' — build succeeds with no errors
Start dev server, navigate to http://localhost:5173/dashboard as public (not logged in) — page renders with new design, 'Read-only' chip visible next to title, status pill shows 'Live' or 'Offline'
If system is online and data is available, KPIs show numeric values (e.g., '3.2 V', '1.5 W', '0.45 A'). If no data, KPIs show '--'.
Open DevTools Network tab, throttle to Offline, hard refresh — status pill shows 'Offline' (red), KPIs show '--', cards are dimmed
Wait 30+ seconds on the page — timestamp updates from 'Last reading 0 min ago' to '1 min ago', etc.
Resize browser to mobile width (<560px) — layout stacks vertically, KPIs in 2-column grid if space allows
Tab through interactive elements with keyboard — focus ring is visible (3px green outline)

Check DevTools Elements inspector: page div has style='backgroundColor: var(--landing-bg)', KPI cards have background: var(--landing-surface), border: 1px solid var(--landing-line), borderRadius: 28px
Hover over 'Read-only' chip — tooltip appears with full text 'You are viewing as a guest...'
